P-H.goal: open Notepad and type ParasiteAI P4.5 verified

farmed_plan.rationale: To open Notepad and type text, Notepad is the standard native text editor on Windows. Since no other text editors are open and Notepad is not explicitly listed in the installed programs list (though it is a standard Windows component launchable via Run or Start), we can launch it using the Windows Run dialog or Start menu search.

steps.description: Open the Windows Run dialog using the Win+R keyboard shortcut.
steps.success_criteria: The Run dialog box appears on the screen.
steps.contingency: Click the Start button and open the search bar instead.

steps.description: Type 'notepad' into the Run dialog input field.
steps.success_criteria: 'notepad' is fully typed into the Run field.

steps.description: Wait for the Notepad application window to open and become active.
steps.success_criteria: An untitled Notepad window is open and focused.

steps.description: Type the required text 'ParasiteAI P4.5 verified' into the Notepad text area.
steps.success_criteria: The text 'ParasiteAI P4.5 verified' is visible inside Notepad.
steps.contingency: Click inside the text area before typing.

steps.description: Verify that the text 'ParasiteAI P4.5 verified' has been successfully typed into Notepad.
steps.success_criteria: The exact string 'ParasiteAI P4.5 verified' is present in Notepad.
steps.contingency: Select all and re-type the text.

P-I.goal: open Notepad and type ParasiteAI P4.5 verified
